APPROVE
The extraction moves the logic unchanged into two helpers, which brings `UnusedWriteScopeGrants` well under 15 and preserves behaviour, but I couldn't find the source on this machine, so the build condition rests on one unchecked assumption: that the `jobs` parameter type `List<(string, List<(int, string)>, int)>` exactly matches what `WorkflowJobs` returns.
